artworks.title: The Triumph of Death: Departure (Le triomphe de la mort: Le depart)
artworks.description: The painting features a skeleton riding a horse and a group of figures marching with long weapons and banners in an organized setting. The central figure is a skeleton draped in a cloth, riding a skeletal horse. To the right, several figures are carrying banners, tridents, and various tools. The background shows large arches. The use of line work and shading creates a dramatic atmosphere. The style is reminiscent of Albrecht Dürer.

artworks.title: Victims of the Lightning (Victimes de la foudre)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a landscape with turbulent weather. The scene features bent, wind-blown trees, swirling clouds, a zigzag line in the sky, rugged ground with fallen branches, and two draped figures. One figure is on the ground while the other is battling against the wind, grasping onto branches.

artworks.title: Sunrise (Un lever de soleil)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed slightly from above, with two people climbing among large boulders on the left-hand side. The horizon is obscured by tall rocks and the slope of the landscape. The scene is depicted in an etching style, with intricate lines creating a textured effect. The color palette is monochromatic, with various shades of brown. In the distance, rocky terrain continues towards the horizon, with detailed trees adding to the setting.

artworks.title: Fishing for Crayfish (Les pecheurs d'ecrevisses)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a body of water in a marshy area. The view is from a slightly elevated position. The horizon is high with rolling hills, few distant trees, and no distinct landmarks. The artwork is in an etching style with fine lines and a monochromatic color palette of sepia and black. Two figures, a man with a rake in the water and a woman standing, are closest, with dense trees and vegetation along the water. The landscape extends into the distance with undulations and sparse vegetation. The sky is intricately lined.

artworks.title: Sir Seymour Haden
Storm (Un orage)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a horizon dividing a turbulent sky and serene water. The horizon features distant land with trees and bushes under a dramatic sky. The brushstrokes convey texture and movement, particularly in the dark clouds dominating the upper portion. The overall palette is monochromatic sepia tone. Other vegetation lines the horizon in the distance. Rain is depicted as dense diagonal lines suggesting a heavy downpour across the scene.

artworks.title: Fagot-gatherer (Le fagotier)
artworks.description: The etching depicts an elderly person in a crouched, almost reclining position on the ground, with most of their body visible and turned to the left side of the frame. The person's head is covered with a cap, and they have a distinct, bushy beard. Their facial features are etched with meticulous detail, showcasing a prominent nose and a calm expression as they appear to be resting or observing something at ground level. The person is dressed in loose-fitting, simple garments. In the immediate surroundings, there is textured detail that suggests a rustic setting, with bundles that resemble hay or straw in the background. The overall background is composed of fine lines and shading, adding depth and a sense of environment to the scene.

artworks.title: Study for the Prodigal Son (Etude pour L'enfant prodigue)
artworks.description: The image shows a figure sitting at the base of a tree. Several tree trunks bisect the scene vertically. The trees are detailed with intricate lines, giving the impression of foliage growth. The left side is dominated by the trees, while the right side fades into a soft, light area. The horizon is not easily visible due to the dense trees and narrow focus. The etching style features delicate, overlapping lines creating depth and texture. The color palette is monochromatic, with variations in line density conveying light and shadow. The figure appears in a contemplative posture, partly obscured by tree shadows.

artworks.title: Man in Punt
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a small boat. The figure is bent over, wearing a hat and coat, and focusing on something within the boat. There are several trees rising from the water, positioned in the middle at varying heights. The horizon is not clearly visible, obscured by the dense trees and lack of background detail. The technique used involves fine etching or scratching for a textured appearance, suggesting shadow and depth. The color palette is monochromatic sepia tones, giving the image a vintage feel.

artworks.title: View of Reeds (Coin de roseau)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with rolling terrain and vegetation from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is high in the composition, with faint indications of fields, barns, and houses obscured by trees. Tall clusters of trees are scattered across the landscape leading to the horizon. A broad tree trunk occupies the right side of the image, adding depth to the scene. The etching technique used in this artwork creates texture in the land and foliage with visible, sketchy lines. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of gray, emphasizing the etching's linear details and shading for a harmonious visual impact.

artworks.title: Landscape with Two Trees (Paysage aux deux arbres)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with trees on the left side, reaching towards the sky. The horizon line is low in the image, emphasizing the trees. In the distance, rooftops are visible among foliage, indicating a rural settlement. The etching uses fine lines and crosshatching for texture and depth in the foliage and sky. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of black and grey. The sky has dynamic lines suggesting movement.

artworks.title: Curious Man (Un curieux)
artworks.description: The image displays an elderly man leaning forward with both arms on a surface. He has a furrowed face, deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and a long, white, textured beard that matches his white hair. He is wearing a simple garment and holding onto a wooden post or cane with his left arm. The background is plain and minimal.

artworks.title: Last Rays (Les derniers rayons)
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape viewed from an elevated position. Rolling hills are visible in the distance, with a small circular structure on the horizon. Fine lines and cross-hatching create texture in the foliage and terrain. The monochromatic color palette includes shades of gray and black. Linear strokes in the sky contrast with detailed lines in the foreground, balancing serenity with intricacy.

artworks.title: At the Home of the Woodcutters (Chez les bocherons)
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with a high horizon, trees, thatched-roof structures, fallen logs, lush foliage, a figure, and a monochromatic color palette dominated by shades of sepia and brown. The etching technique highlights detailed textures and shapes, creating depth and complexity.

artworks.title: Landscape (Paysage)
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape viewed from a slightly elevated point. The horizon is high in the image, with an open landscape meeting low hills in the distance. More trees and faint buildings are visible on the horizon. The art style is an etching with precise line work, crosshatched for texture and shading. The color palette is monochrome, with shades of gray and black created by etched lines. Closest to us is a figure among lush vegetation, under large trees framing the scene. In the middle distance are more trees and shrubs leading to a river or stream. The overall feeling of the image is a peaceful and expansive rural setting.

artworks.title: Dr. Louis Vintras
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of Dr. Louis Vintras focusing on his face and upper torso. He is depicted in a straightforward position, facing the viewer with a serious expression. Dr. Vintras has a mustache, deep-set eyes, a furrowed brow, short neat hair, and is dressed in a formal suit with a tie. The background is plain with no additional elements. Inscriptions at the top corners read "Dr. Louis Vintras" on the left and "A. Legros 1904" on the right.

artworks.title: Footbridge (La passerelle)
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape scene from a low vantage point by a body of water with a wooden plank bridge. Hills, buildings, trees, and grass are illustrated with detailed cross-hatching. The color scheme is monochrome using black and shades of gray on a light background. Various trees are depicted to the left, with delicate foliage. In the distance, the landscape includes rolling terrain, structures, and wispy trails.

artworks.title: Shepherd's Hut on a Hillside  (Bergerie sur le coteau)
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic scene with a subtly sloping land suggesting a horizon. A thatched-roof structure is slightly off-center to the right on the horizon. Two slender trees on the left have detailed branches and leaves. The etching technique emphasizes texture and lines like straw on the roof and bark on the trees. The monochromatic palette consists of sepia tones, providing a soft and timeless visual impact that highlights the scene's intricacies without color.

artworks.title: Return to the Farm (Le retour a la ferme)
artworks.description: The image displays a rural scene with trees, figures engaged in various activities, and distant hills. Fine, detailed etching technique gives texture to the scene, with a monochromatic color palette using shades of gray to capture depth. The focus is on the interplay of light and shadow across the landscape.

artworks.title: Valley in Bourgogne (Une vallee en Bourgogne)
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape from a high vantage point. Rolling hills, vegetation, and a distant village are visible. The horizon is high in the frame, with the lower portion showing hills and vegetation. The perspective leads the eye towards the village, which has clustered buildings. The etching technique uses fine lines for detail and texture. The color palette is monochromatic with various shades of gray. Details are intricate in the foreground, while the background has softer contours.

artworks.title: Valley in Bourgogne (Une vallee en Bourgogne)
artworks.description: The image features a landscape viewed from an elevated point, showing a serene scene with trees dominating the middle ground and background, obscuring the horizon. The fine brushstrokes create intricate details in the foliage, giving texture and movement to the leaves. The monochromatic palette of blacks and grays provides contrast and a classic feel. Two figures are depicted near a body of water, with reflections of the surrounding scenery. The stream leads towards dense thickets and onwards.

artworks.title: Little Burner of Grass (Le petit bruleur d'herbe)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on buff paper
artworks.description: The image shows a natural scene with a small settlement. In the foreground, there is a large, gnarled tree with thick roots. A stone path leads to several rustic buildings with stone walls and tile roofs. The background is blurred by bushes and trees, indicating a thick wood behind the buildings. The artwork employs fine, detailed etching strokes to create texture in the foliage and architecture. The color palette is monochrome sepia, enhancing the detailed line work of the etching.

artworks.title: The Tree of Salvation (L'arbe de salut)
artworks.medium: drypoint and etching? on buff paper
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body figures of women kneeling on the ground. The woman on the left has her head bowed and covers her face with her hands, sitting slightly behind the other. Her hair is hidden beneath a scarf. The woman on the right is kneeling closer to a large tree with notices or documents tacked to it; she is leaning forward with one hand on the ground. Her head is also covered with a scarf, and her hair is not visible. Both women are wearing long dresses with headscarves, and there is a pair of shoes on the ground nearby alongside a basket or coiled object. In the background, a bare tree branch extends overhead. The scene has a textured, cross-hatched rendering, giving it a somber tone. The distant ground and undefined sky provide a muted backdrop to the scene.

artworks.title: Avalanche: Frontispiece for Triumph of Death (L'avalanche: Frontispice du Triomphe dela mort
artworks.description: The image shows a stone with the words "TRIOMPHE DE LA MORT" partially obscured by branches and foliage. The composition is close-up, focusing on details. The etching style uses fine lines and cross-hatching for texture. The color palette is monochrome in shades of sepia or brown. A scythe and a skull are depicted. The scene suggests a dense natural environment with layers of texture.
